{{Top|leg}}
'''''Garble''''' was a [[Class-A cargo container]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as part of a starfighter depot that was attacked and destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']].
